patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors, often featuring a large, centered heading followed by a grid of images or text blocks.
Extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings for main sections, creating strong visual anchors and a commanding presence.
A high-contrast dark theme (predominantly black/dark grey) punctuated by full-bleed sections in vibrant, solid colors like deep blue, orange, and dark purple.
A sticky header with the brand logo and navigation icon remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the page content scrolls underneath it.
Content sections and individual elements (like image cards or text blocks) appear to animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as the user scrolls down the page.
Each major service or content category (e.g., 'BRAND,' 'DIGITAL,' 'REPORTING') is presented as a distinct, full-width section with its own background color and a prominent, oversized heading.

technique_notes: A fixed header element is used, which becomes sticky at the top of the viewport, allowing the main page content to scroll beneath it.

Scroll-triggered animations are employed to reveal content. As sections enter the viewport, elements within them (like headings, images, and text blocks) animate into place with a subtle upward translation and fade-in effect, likely orchestrated by a scroll library like locomotive-scroll in conjunction with css-keyframes.
The site uses full-bleed, high-contrast color blocks for distinct content sections, where large white typography is set against dark, saturated backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body text) with clear, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on image cards and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, particularly around large headings and between major content sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and clear hierarchy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of massive, bold, uppercase typography for section titles, combined with full-bleed, high-contrast color blocks, creates a powerful, almost architectural visual rhythm. The large, stylized 'DRIFTTIME' logo in the footer acts as a strong brand anchor.
